toolchain_note: Restored ephemeral toolchain (jdk4py 25.0.2.1, ECJ 3.16.0 from npm coc-java@1.0.0, api jars and ProGuard from vipaoL/j2me-build-tools). New classes bind inherited getWidth/getHeight to javax/microedition/lcdui/Displayable, which resolves identically on a real MIDP 2.0 device; pixel-linage classes are NOT repackaged in this jar.

diagnostic.purpose: Price the fixed ~30 ms geometry/setup term at the measured S50+UP working point; test how much of it is reducible per-triangle via far distance and a screen-radius cell reject. No handset FPS claim.
diagnostic.map: old sym9 village/river map from immutable Perspective/Tex3 parent: maps/kordos/kordos.3d, baked lightmap/kordod.vla, Tex3 slots forest/map-selo1/river
diagnostic.renderer: source fork of the published RiverPixelMesh with two added knobs; defaults F60000/L0 reproduce the parent draw stream exactly (pinned by the 144-pose sweep test); stats fork is a re-type of RiverPixelStats
diagnostic.delivery: identical DIR/UP stack from the published upscale diagnostic: DIR black bars at 1:1, UP Image.getRGB + integer nearest-neighbour expand + Graphics.drawRGB false-alpha; upscaleNN copied verbatim

handset_model_prior.area_model: R ~= 30 ms fixed + ~74 ms x full-screen area, confirmed S100/S75/S50/S25
handset_model_prior.upscale_price: full-screen delivery constant ~24-33 ms; S50 UP FPS 9.1 vs S100 DIR 7.0; S75 UP dead point; S25 UP ~12.8 at 4x grain
handset_model_prior.why_now: at S50 the fixed ~30 ms term is ~60% of R; per-triangle reduction should show up directly, unlike at S100 where fill dominated

diagnostic.default: S100 DIR F60K L0 B (full viewport, bars delivery, far 60000, radius limit off, base-level filtering)

controls.key1: BASE reset: S100 + DIR + F60K + L0 + BASE_LEVEL
controls.key0: cycle render scale 100 -> 75 -> 50 -> 25 percent (other toggles preserved)
controls.key3: toggle delivery DIR <-> UP (identical to upscale diagnostic)
controls.key7: cycle far 60000 -> 40000 -> 20000 (projection + frustum distance; river/fog untouched)
controls.key9: cycle screen-radius cell reject L 0 -> 8 -> 16 render-viewport pixels; whole GRID cells whose full-bounds sphere projects below L are dropped, camera-inside cells never cut
controls.star: toggle texture level filter BASE_LEVEL <-> NEAREST nearest mip level (hint, may be ignored)

diagnostic.line1: S{scale} {DIR|UP} F{60K|40K|20K} L{0|8|16} {B|M}; warming or FPS
diagnostic.line2: T submitted triangles (last publish) + N/R/C/I; T is the geometry-knob witness
diagnostic.m3g_compatibility: Target user-reported Nokia E65 M3G 1.0: same JSR-184 1.0 entry points as the pixel/upscale diagnostics
diagnostic.alpha: original thresholds in TEX modes, as parent
diagnostic.depth: test/write ON except river write OFF, as parent
diagnostic.river: all 4 cached frames, speed6, mode7, as parent
diagnostic.pump: same worker repaint()+serviceRepaints()+sleep(1) in all modes, as parent
diagnostic.stats_note: T/N/R/C/I are Java API wall time / submission counts, NOT GPU timestamps or proven LCD flips

purpose: Isolated river-map geometry-cost A/B at the S50+UP working point: far cycle and screen-radius cell reject over the handset-proven delivery stack.
